item.name: The Deer
item.location: Forest at night; campfire area when the fire is out
item.spawnCondition: Night threat tied to the campfire safe zone and the missing children objective.
item.bestAction: Stay near a lit campfire, use the flashlight stun window when needed, and do not treat it like a normal kill target.
item.damage: 25+; source says it varies by day and hunger
item.walkspeed: 35+; source says it can get faster during longer chases

item.name: The Owl
item.spawnCondition: Can replace The Deer as the active night monster.
item.bestAction: Stop moving during the detection minigame, then use flashlight stun only after a chase starts.
item.damage: 25+; source says it varies by day

item.name: The Ram
item.spawnCondition: One of the possible secondary monsters depending on biome conditions.
item.bestAction: Sidestep its charge, use flashlight while it is walking rather than charging, and avoid relying on trees as permanent cover.
item.damage: 25+; source says it varies by day

item.name: The Bat
item.location: Underground areas, Bat Cave, and Caverns
item.spawnCondition: Cave-only major threat.
item.bestAction: Hide behind cover during the screech cue; flashlight stun is not listed as a counter.
item.walkspeed: Flies; no numeric walk speed listed

item.name: The Cat
item.spawnCondition: Major monster encounter with a pounce attack.
item.bestAction: Keep spacing for the pounce and avoid committing to narrow routes before its attack is clear.

item.name: Cultist King
item.location: Cultist King Palace in the Volcanic Biome
item.spawnCondition: Summoned by placing four Cultist Gems on the palace pedestals; source says once per day.
item.drops: Mossy Coins, Cultist King Antler, Volcanic Bear Trap Tablet, and one infernal weapon or sack reward
item.bestAction: Prepare ranged damage and an exit plan before summoning; use the palace doorway, high ground, or lava trap route rather than face-tanking.
item.hp: Huge health pool; no exact value listed

item.name: Frog King
item.role: Frog Cave boss guarding the Frog Chest
item.spawnCondition: Appears as the boss of the Frog Cave during Frog Invasion content.
item.drops: No direct drop list found; defeating it opens the route to Frog Chest rewards
item.bestAction: Clear space before killing it because the source says it spawns weaker frogs after death.
item.availability: Active available listing; tied to Frog Invasion content

item.name: Melee Cultist
item.location: Cultist bases, strongholds, raids, camps, trees, temples, and related cultist locations
item.spawnCondition: Appears as part of cultist groups and campfire raids.
item.drops: Mossy Coins, ammo, cultist body, and possible cultist-family rewards depending on location or event
item.bestAction: Kite or fight from range, especially during raids where melee enemies can stack around camp defenses.
item.hp: 100-150 in many natural/raid encounters; stronghold variants scale by level
item.damage: 7 with Old Axe; 15 with Spear; 30 with Morningstar

item.name: Crossbow Cultist
item.location: Cultist bases, strongholds, raids, camps, trees, temples, and related cultist locations
item.spawnCondition: Appears in cultist groups and raids, especially where ranged pressure matters.
item.drops: Mossy Coins, ammo, cultist body, and possible cultist-family rewards depending on location or event
item.bestAction: Rush or line-of-sight it before dealing with slower melee enemies, since source tips call out ranged cultists as dangerous but weak up close.
item.hp: 100-150 in many natural/raid encounters; stronghold variants scale by level

item.name: Juggernaut Cultist
item.spawnCondition: Appears as a stronger cultist variant.
item.bestAction: Do not let it pin the campfire route; use range, traps, or team focus before lighter enemies overwhelm the base.
item.hp: Source lists cultist health ranges, but no clean unique Juggernaut HP was verified

item.name: Wolf
item.role: Early hostile animal and pelt source
item.location: Forest, Snow, Volcanic areas, locked caves, and cabins
item.spawnCondition: Common night and guardian enemy; source also lists locked cave guardians.
item.drops: Morsel 2-3, Steak 1, Wolf Pelt 0-1; guardian wolves can drop Red Key
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists a Steak or Morsel route. Full feeding steps belong to tameable animals.
item.bestAction: Fight from range or tame only when you have the right flute and food; watch for guardian key versions in caves.

item.name: Alpha Wolf
item.role: Stronger wolf and better pelt source
item.location: Forest, any biome at higher campfire level, locked cave 2, and Cultist Hunter Camp
item.spawnCondition: Source lists campfire level 3+ conditions and guardian versions.
item.drops: Morsel 2-3, Steak 1, Alpha Wolf Pelt 0-1; guardian alpha wolves can drop Blue Key
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Good Flute or better with Steak, Mackerel, or Salmon routes.
item.bestAction: Treat it as a faster wolf; kite or tame only when prepared with stronger flute and food.

item.name: Bear
item.role: Heavy animal threat and pelt source
item.location: Forest, Cultist Hunter Camp, and locked caves
item.spawnCondition: Source lists campfire level 5+ for forest spawns, with some Cultist Hunter Camp exceptions.
item.drops: Morsel 6, Steak 3-4, Bear Pelt 0-1; guardian bears can drop Yellow or Grey Key
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Strong Flute or better with Steak, Pumpkin, or Salmon routes.
item.bestAction: Avoid early fights; use range, traps, or taming prep because it has much higher HP and damage than wolves.

item.name: Polar Bear
item.location: Snow Biome and Polar Bear Cave
item.spawnCondition: Source lists Snow Biome level 4+ and notes older forest/snowy patch behavior.
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Strong Flute or better with Rib, Stew, or Swordfish routes.
item.bestAction: Do not enter snow routes under-geared; kite or tame with high-tier preparation.

item.name: Aliens
item.spawnCondition: Source says UFO events can begin at night from Day 3 and one green-glow UFO leads to the Mothership.
item.drops: No clean shared drop list verified
item.bestAction: Bring weapons for ranged and melee alien gear; treat Alien Elites as keycard blockers rather than normal animals.
item.availability: Active available listing; tied to alien event route
item.hp: Medium in source; no exact value listed

item.name: Arctic Fox
item.spawnCondition: Source lists Snow Biome level 2+ and groups up to 2-5.
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Steak and Chili route details.
item.bestAction: Respect its speed in groups; kite before harvesting pelts or attempt taming when prepared.

item.name: Frogs
item.role: Pond and Frog Cave enemy chain
item.location: Forest ponds, Jungle, Frog Cave, and pond locations
item.spawnCondition: Source says they emerge from ponds after about 10 minutes and do not appear every run.
item.tamingRequirement: Only green frogs are listed as tameable; source lists Old Flute and Mackerel summary.
item.bestAction: Avoid triggering a bad chain in tight space; killed frogs can spawn weaker frogs, so clear the area deliberately.
item.availability: Active available listing; tied to Frog Invasion content
item.damage: 5 plus poison effect noted by source

item.name: Scorpion
item.spawnCondition: Source lists regular volcanic spawns and faster Scorpion Nest versions.
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Steak and Morsel route details.
item.bestAction: Do not ignore poison ticks; keep distance or clear them before looting volcanic routes.

item.name: Hellephant
item.location: Volcanic Biome and Hellephant Ritual Circle
item.spawnCondition: Source says it can respawn after two days.
item.drops: Cooked Steak 8-9, Cooked Ribs 0-2, Mammoth Tusk 0-1
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Strong Flute or better with Pumpkin and Cake summary.
item.bestAction: Treat it as a hostile high-HP mammoth: use strong weapons, space, or taming prep before engaging.

item.name: Meteor Crab
item.location: Meteor Crater and Meteor Tool Workshop
item.spawnCondition: Source says three Meteor Crabs inhabit the Meteor Tool Workshop.
item.bestAction: Clear them before looting the workshop because the meteor route depends on the crater/tool-workshop area.
item.availability: Active available listing; tied to Meteor Event content

item.name: Shadow Cultist
item.spawnCondition: Appears in cave routes.
item.bestAction: Handle it as a cave ambush threat and do not expect material drops for the fight.

item.name: Brute Cultist
item.spawnCondition: Source says it appears in deeper or final cave contexts where it can replace Shadow Cultists.
item.bestAction: Do not trade hits unless heavily geared; use range or group focus because its HP and damage are high.

item.name: Darkstring Cultist
item.location: Underground caves and Hard Mode raids
item.spawnCondition: Appears in advanced cultist/cave content.
item.bestAction: Prioritize cover and close the angle carefully; source says it fires two bolts and reloads faster.
item.damage: High; no exact numeric value listed
item.walkspeed: Medium; no exact numeric value listed

item.name: Boar
item.spawnCondition: Source lists Jungle spawns.
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Old Flute or better with Corn and Morsel summary.
item.bestAction: Treat it as a jungle threat and food source, but do not rely on unverified exact combat stats.

item.name: Poison Spear Jungle Cultist
item.role: Melee jungle cultist with poison armor
item.spawnCondition: Appears in Jungle cultist encounters.
item.bestAction: Avoid melee chip damage from poison armor and use range when possible.
item.damage: 30/45 listed for Jungle Cultists; source does not split by weapon

item.name: Blowpipe Jungle Cultist
item.role: Ranged jungle cultist with poison armor
item.spawnCondition: Appears in Jungle cultist encounters.
item.bestAction: Use cover and close safely; treat poison armor as a reason to avoid careless melee hits.
item.damage: 30/45 listed for Jungle Cultists; source does not split by weapon

item.name: Bunny
item.role: Early food, foot drop, and taming target
item.spawnCondition: Common passive animal spawn.
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Old Flute or better and Carrot.
item.bestAction: Farm for early food or Bunny Foot, or tame when you are ready to spend carrots.

item.name: Horse
item.spawnCondition: Spawns only with the Furniture Trader wagon according to source notes.
item.bestAction: Avoid killing it unless you need the meat; source says the wagon disappears but the Furniture Trader can still trade.

item.name: Kiwi
item.spawnCondition: Source lists campfire level 6 Kiwi Burrow condition.
item.bestAction: Carry it like a rescue target or tame it; do not try to farm drops.

item.name: Turkey
item.location: Autumnal Patch and lobby-related Thanksgiving source contexts
item.spawnCondition: Thanksgiving event-origin animal; source currently marks it temporarily gone.
item.bestAction: Treat it as an event-origin row, not a normal active farm target.

item.name: Chick
item.location: Easter forest and Easter decoration spawns
item.spawnCondition: Event-origin animal tied to Easter content in source.
item.bestAction: Use it as a tameable/event-origin row rather than a normal drop farm.

item.name: Mammoth
item.spawnCondition: Source lists Snow Biome level 4+ and respawn after a day.
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Strong Flute or better with Pumpkin and Cake summary.
item.bestAction: Leave it alone unless you are prepared to tame or kill a tanky neutral target.

item.name: Mossy Mammoth
item.spawnCondition: Source lists Jungle Biome level 4+ and respawn after a day.
item.tamingRequirement: Tameable; source lists Strong Flute or better with Pumpkin and Cake summary.
item.bestAction: Avoid provoking it unless the group is ready for a tanky knockback fight or a taming route.

item.name: Dino Kid
item.spawnCondition: First missing child; source notes reveal around campfire level 2 or sometimes level 3.
item.drops: Rescue progress; rescuing a child increases the day counter by 1
item.bestAction: Clear the five red-collar wolf guards, then carry the child back to camp.

item.name: Kraken Kid
item.spawnCondition: Second missing child; source notes reveal around campfire level 4 or sometimes level 5.
item.drops: Rescue progress; rescuing a child increases the day counter by 1
item.bestAction: Bring the blue key route prep, clear four blue-collar alpha wolves, then carry the child back.

item.name: Squid Kid
item.spawnCondition: Third missing child; source notes reveal around campfire level 5 or sometimes level 6.
item.drops: Rescue progress; rescuing a child increases the day counter by 1
item.bestAction: Prepare for two yellow-collar bear guards before committing to the cave rescue.

item.name: Koala Kid
item.spawnCondition: Final missing child; source notes campfire level 6 and six black-collar bear guards.
item.drops: Rescue progress; rescuing a child increases the day counter by 1
item.bestAction: Treat this as the hardest rescue cave and enter with bear-fight tools, healing, and a carry route.

item.name: Pelt Trader
item.location: Near campfire and Missing Child board
item.spawnCondition: First appears Day 2, then source says every 3-4 days and leaves at night.
item.drops: Trades Bunny Foot, Wolf Pelt, Alpha Wolf Pelt, and Bear Pelt for upgrade choices
item.bestAction: Save pelts and visit before night if you want upgrades instead of raw material storage.

item.name: Furniture Trader
item.spawnCondition: May arrive on the map and travels with the Horse.
item.bestAction: Bring Mossy Coins when you want furniture; do not confuse the trader with the Horse's meat drop.

item.name: Fairy
item.location: Outside Mushroom House in the Fairy Biome
item.spawnCondition: Appears at the Mushroom House with nearby flower garden context.
item.drops: Sells seed boxes for Flowers; source lists prices rising by 20 after each purchase
item.bestAction: Farm flowers before visiting so the trip can turn into seed boxes immediately.

item.name: Bird Watcher
item.spawnCondition: Source says this NPC is no longer in the game.
item.drops: Formerly offered Fuel Canisters for Feathers and Gem of the Forest Fragment after enough Feathers
item.bestAction: Do not route around this NPC in normal runs; keep the row only to prevent stale-guide confusion.

item.name: Tool Trader
item.spawnCondition: Source lists Fire level 3.
item.drops: Sells Fishing Rods and Taming Flutes for 20 Mossy Coins; includes an upgrade stand for tools
item.bestAction: Bring Mossy Coins when you need fishing or flute progression; do not expect a combat drop.
item.availability: Active available listing; page is a stub

item.name: Happy The Halloween Guy
item.location: Halloween lobby or carnival source context
item.spawnCondition: Halloween event-origin NPC; source currently marks it temporarily gone.
item.drops: Halloween shop interaction; no combat drops
item.bestAction: Treat as a stale-guide clarity row unless Halloween content returns.

item.name: Christmas Elves
item.spawnCondition: Christmas-exclusive passive NPCs; source currently marks them temporarily gone.
item.drops: Yellow Present reward after rescue with required special tools
item.bestAction: Do not plan a normal run around them unless the Christmas event returns.

item.name: Mega Cultist
item.spawnCondition: Source says it can only be spawned manually by developers during update parties.
item.drops: No normal player-facing drop table verified
item.bestAction: Do not treat this as a normal run goal; it is useful mostly for identifying admin/update-party footage.

item.name: Evil Bunny
item.location: Forest, Easter Bunny's Egg House, and campfire level 6 source context
item.spawnCondition: Source says it spawns after stealing the egg in Easter content.
item.drops: Ruby Chest reward when the egg is returned
item.bestAction: Treat as event-only/temporarily gone; source says it cannot be stunned.
